AFDAnnotation.description: Describes the AFD Code in textual form and indicates which coded frame type is being used as referenced by SMPTE ST2016-1:2009.

BarData.title: BarData
BarData.description: Used to define the structure of bar data in a video source as referenced by SMPTE ST2016-1:2009.

AFDData.description: Used to describe both Active Format Description Codes, Shorthand Text Descriptions and Bar Data options. (v3.0)

ChromaSubsampling.description: The practice of encoding images by implementing less resolution for chroma information than for luma information, taking advantage of the human visual system's lower acuity for color differences than for luminance. (v6.0)

ChromaSubsample4-2-0.title: ChromaSubsample4-2-0

Colorimetry4-2-0.title: Colorimetry4-2-0
Colorimetry4-2-0.description: Note: COLOR.3 only applies to ITU-R BT.709 delivered material and COLOR.8 [DPP] corresponds to the HLG system specified in Recommendation ITU-R BT.2100

ChromaSubsample4-2-0.description: C'b and C'r are each subsampled at a factor of 2 both horizontally and vertically.

ChromaSubsample4-2-2.title: ChromaSubsample4-2-2

Colorimetry4-2-2.title: Colorimetry4-2-2
Colorimetry4-2-2.description: Note: COLOR.3 only applies to ITU-R BT.709 delivered material and COLOR.8 corresponds to the HLG system specified in Recommendation ITU-R BT.2100

ChromaSubsample4-2-2.description: The two chroma components are sampled at half the sample rate of luma: the horizontal chroma resolution is halved. This reduces the bandwidth of an uncompressed video signal by one-third with little to no visual difference.

ChromaSubsample4-4-4.title: ChromaSubsample4-4-4

Colorimetry4-4-4.title: Colorimetry4-4-4
Colorimetry4-4-4.description: Note: COLOR.8 corresponds to the HLG system specified in Recommendation ITU-R BT.2100

ChromaSubsample4-4-4.description: Each of the three Y'C'bC'r components have the same sample rate, thus there is no chroma subsampling.

DynamicRange.description: Used to indicate whether the video content has either a standard dynamic range (SDR) or a high dynamic range (HDR). (v7.0)

BT.601.title: BT.601

BT.709.title: BT.709

BT.2020.title: BT.2020

HDR.title: HDR

MAXCLL.title: MAXCLL
MAXCLL.description: Maximum Content Light Level - the luma of the brightest pixel.

MAXFALL.title: MAXFALL
MAXFALL.description: Maximum Frame Average Light Level - the highest frame average brightness within the content.

HDR.description: High Dynamic Range used with Ultra High Definition Television and 1080p

Stereoscopy.title: Stereoscopy

FrameRate.title: FrameRate

ChromaSubsampling.description: The practice of encoding images by implementing less resolution for chroma information than for luma information, taking advantage of the human visual system's lower acuity for color differences than for luminance.

ImageEssence.description: Description of the video image essence for ProRes, J2K and others. (v6.0)

PixelBitDepth.title: PixelBitDepth
PixelBitDepth.description: Pixel Bit Depth must be either set as a value of 8 or 10.

IMFChromaSubsample4-2-2.description: The two chroma components are sampled at half the sample rate of luma: the horizontal chroma resolution is halved. This reduces the bandwidth of an uncompressed video signal by one-third with little to no visual difference. (v6.0)

ImageFrameWidth.title: ImageFrameWidth
ImageFrameWidth.description: The width of the frame is defined as the number of horizontal pixel elements and must be an integer no greater than 1920.

ImageFrameHeight.title: ImageFrameHeight
ImageFrameHeight.description: The height of the frame is defined as the number of vertical pixel elements and must be an integer.  If interlaced, the number must be even and can be no greater than 1080.

FrameStructure.title: FrameStructure

Progressive.title: Progressive

Stereoscopy-P.title: Stereoscopy-P
Stereoscopy-P.description: Can be either stereoscopic or monscopic.

FrameRate-P.title: FrameRate-P
FrameRate-P.description: Multiple frame rate speeds are supported under progressive structure,

IMFChromaSubsampling-P.title: IMFChromaSubsampling-P

IMFChromaSubsample4-2-2.title: IMFChromaSubsample4-2-2
IMFChromaSubsample4-2-2.description: The two chroma components are sampled at half the sample rate of luma: the horizontal chroma resolution is halved. This reduces the bandwidth of an uncompressed video signal by one-third with little to no visual difference.

IMFChromaSubsample4-4-4.title: IMFChromaSubsample4-4-4

Quantization4-4-4.title: Quantization4-4-4
Quantization4-4-4.description: If set to QE.2, other componenst are restricted.

ColorComponents4-4-4.title: ColorComponents4-4-4
ColorComponents4-4-4.description: If Quantization = QE.2 then this must be R'G'B'.

Colorimetry4-4-4.title: Colorimetry4-4-4
Colorimetry4-4-4.description: If Quantization = QE.2 then this must be COLOR.3.

PixelBitDepth.title: PixelBitDepth
PixelBitDepth.description: Pixel Bit Depth must be either set as a value of 8 or 10.

IMFChromaSubsample4-4-4.description: Each of the three Y'CbCr components have the same sample rate, thus there is no chroma subsampling.

IMFChromaSubsampling-P.description:
COLOR.1
Mapped as specified for 625-line systems in Section 2.6 of Recommendation ITU-R BT.601
COLOR.2
Mapped as specified for 525-line systems in Section 2.6 of Recommendation ITU-R BT.601
COLOR.3
Mapped as specified in Section 1 of Part 2 of Recommendation ITU-R BT.709

Progressive.description: An image frame with progressive structure shall consist of a complete image frame, scanned progressively left to right and from top to bottom.

Interlaced.title: Interlaced

Stereoscopy-I.title: Stereoscopy-I
Stereoscopy-I.description: Restricted to only allow monoscopic as an option.

FrameRate-I.title: FrameRate-I
FrameRate-I.description: When interlaced frame structure is used, the field rate, i.e. the number of image fields per second, shall be twice the frame rate.

IMFChromaSubsampling-I.title: IMFChromaSubsampling-I

IMFChromaSubsample4-2-2.title: IMFChromaSubsample4-2-2
IMFChromaSubsample4-2-2.description: The two chroma components are sampled at half the sample rate of luma: the horizontal chroma resolution is halved. This reduces the bandwidth of an uncompressed video signal by one-third with little to no visual difference.

IMFChromaSubsampling-I.description:
COLOR.1
Mapped as specified for 625-line systems in Section 2.6 of Recommendation ITU-R BT.601
COLOR.2
Mapped as specified for 525-line systems in Section 2.6 of Recommendation ITU-R BT.601
COLOR.3
Mapped as specified in Section 1 of Part 2 of Recommendation ITU-R BT.709

Interlaced.description: An image frame with interlaced structure shall consist of a pair of fields, a first field then a second field. The lines of each field shall have twice the vertical spatial sampling pitch of the frame. Lines in the second field shall be displaced vertically by the vertical sampling pitch and the line timing shall be delayed temporally by half the frame time from the lines in the first field. Image frames with an interlaced image structure shall have an even number of vertical pixels.

FrameStructure.description: Under IMF there is the option of Progressive or Interlaced frame structures.

J2KEncodingProfile-SD.title: J2KEncodingProfile-SD
J2KEncodingProfile-SD.description: Implementations shall support the profile and level combinations utilizing JPEG 2000 Profiles as specified in ISO/IEC 15444-1 Amendment 3.

IMFImageEssenceApp2.description: Description of the video image essence for IMF Applications as a specialization of the IMF Framework. (v6.0)

ImageFrameWidth.title: ImageFrameWidth
ImageFrameWidth.description: The width of the frame is defined as the number of horizontal pixel elements and must be an integer. Note that for Widths>3840, COLOR.4 is not supported and sampling must be 4:4:4 and R'G'B'.

ImageFrameHeight.title: ImageFrameHeight
ImageFrameHeight.description: The height of the frame is defined as the number of vertical pixel elements and must be an integer. Note that for Heights greater than 2160, COLOR.4 is not supported and sampling must be 4:4:4 and R'G'B'.

FrameStructure.title: FrameStructure

Progressive.title: Progressive

Stereoscopy-P.title: Stereoscopy-P
Stereoscopy-P.description: Can be either stereoscopic or monscopic.

FrameRate-P.title: FrameRate-P
FrameRate-P.description: Note that 120 fps is only available with FrameWidth>3840 and FrameHeight>2160.

IMFApp2eChromaSubsampling-P.title: IMFApp2eChromaSubsampling-P

IMFApp2eChromaSubsample4-2-2.title: IMFApp2eChromaSubsample4-2-2

PixelBitDepth.title: PixelBitDepth
PixelBitDepth.description: Under IMF-App2e, Pixel Bit Depth can be 8,10,12,16, but values are further restricted based on the Colorimetry used.  COLOR.3 and COLOR.4 allows 8 and 10, COLOR.5 allows 10 and 12 and COLOR.7 allows 10, 12, or 16.

IMFApp2eChromaSubsample4-2-2.description: In 4:2:2 Y’C’bC’r sampling, the Y’ component shall be sampled at each pixel, but the C’r and C’b components shall be horizontally subsampled by a factor of two with respect to the Y' component, co-sited with even-numbered Y’ samples (See Section 5.1.3.9 in SMPTE ST 2067-20:2016).

IMFApp2eChromaSubsample4-4-4.title: IMFApp2eChromaSubsample4-4-4

ColorComponents4-4-4.title: ColorComponents4-4-4
ColorComponents4-4-4.description: If Quantization = QE.2 then this must be R'G'B'.

Colorimetry4-4-4.title: Colorimetry4-4-4
Colorimetry4-4-4.description: If Quantization = QE.2 then this must be COLOR.3 (Section 5.2 Table 4).

PixelBitDepth.title: PixelBitDepth
PixelBitDepth.description: Under IMF-App2e, Pixel Bit Depth can be 8,10,12,16, but values are further restricted based on the Colorimetry used.  COLOR.3 allows 8 and 10, COLOR.5 allows 10 and 12 and COLOR.6 and COLOR.7 allows 10, 12, or 16.

IMFApp2eChromaSubsample4-4-4.description: In 4:4:4 sampling, each component shall be sampled once at each image frame pixel  (See Section 5.1.3.9 in SMPTE ST 2067-20:2016).

IMFApp2eChromaSubsampling-P.description: See section 5.2 under SMPTE ST 2067-21 for further details.

Progressive.description: An image frame with progressive structure shall consist of a complete image frame, scanned progressively left to right and from top to bottom.

FrameStructure.description: Under IMFApp2e only Progressive is allowed.

J2K-SD-IMF.title: J2K-SD-IMF
J2K-SD-IMF.description: Implementations shall support the profile and level combinations utilizing JPEG 2000 Profiles as specified in ISO/IEC 15444-1 Amendment 3.

J2KEncodingProfile-IMF.description: Implementations shall support the combinations of JPEG 2000 profiles (as specified in ISO/IEC 15444-1 Amd.7) and image frame dimensions listed in Table 5, which replaces Table 5 in ST 2067-20.

IMFImageEssenceApp2e.description: Description of the video image essence for IMF Applications as a specialization of the IMF Framework.  All references are taken from SMPTE ST 2067-21:2016 Clause 5.1 and reference Table 3. (v6.0).
